purpose: The queries this repo has evidence for. Contrast with data/queries/citation_fanout_opportunities_100k/, which holds 100,000 template concatenations and is planning intelligence, never a publishing queue. The policy in data/authority_scale/query_atlas.json already said pages may only be generated against T1-T3 evidence; this file plus the validator is what enforces it.

domain_note: data/site.json publishes this repo at theindustryguides.com, which is the velocity FEEDER for the five canonical guide domains (uscisexam.com, hormonesivhair.com, theaccidentguides.com, dentistryguides.com, neuroevalguides.com). Overlap between the feeder and those domains is the architecture working, not duplication. The Semrush packet maps some queries here to the canonical domains; target_domain is carried through as the packet assigned it. Where a query is mapped to a canonical domain that currently serves no pages, that is a build-out gap on a real property - not a mapping error, and not a reason to retire anything.
owner_seed_policy: An owner may add a record with source_type owner_approved_seed and volume null. It must carry approved_by and approved_at. A record may also be added at evidence_tier T3 (real phrasing, no volume) when a measurement establishes the query is really asked and the network has no page for it. It must carry source_type, provenance naming the measurement set in provenance_sets, and volume null - T3 never asserts a volume.

domain_policy.note: No domain in this portfolio is retired or consolidated away. Individual manufactured pages may be retired with evidence; properties may not.

citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.measured: Answer-engine citation shape: for each query the incumbent was measured absent or weak, AND no page anywhere in the network answers it.
citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.not_measured: search_volume, impressions_90d, keyword_difficulty and cpc_usd are unknown for every row in this set and are carried as null. No page may print a volume figure for these queries.
citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.collapse_rule: Per data/strategy/page_strategy_registry.json: a wording variation is not a distinct page intent. The clearest phrasing was kept and the absorbed phrasings are recorded on the surviving row under collapsed_from.
citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.row_order: Rows are stored in lead-intent priority order (T1 local/ready-to-buy, then T2 cost/in-market, then T3 selection/evaluating, then T4 informational). This is POSITIONAL ONLY. No consumer of this file sorts on it, and no priority field was invented: rank_score is required to be null for rows with demand_basis=none, so there is no existing ordering field to populate. scripts/queries/ingest_gsc_evidence.py re-sorts this file on every successful GSC ingest, at which point the positional order is lost.
